pages.title: Stellar Containment Plate
pages.text: A plate of degenerate armour and spacetime alloy over magnetic confinement casing, built to hold back the pressure and heat of a star. It is impossibly heavy and faintly warm. Heat haze clings to its face even when the machine it guards is cold and silent.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Stellar machines needed walls that would not buckle. I combined degenerate armour plate with spacetime alloy and magnetic confinement, and the plate held a star's pressure.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.
